common_name: Seychelles Morinda-Specialist Fly (Loss of Larval Shavenbaby Trichomes)
scale_statement: 1.5 µm detail scale (1.548e-06 m, log10=-5.810, tier 3_subcellular_um), Holocene age 0 Ma

phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Drosophila sechellia (1.5 µm, detail scale)

equations.pde: du/dt = Du lap u + fu u + fv v - u^3; dv/dt = Dv lap v + gu u + gv v
equations.k_c: k_c^2 = (Dv fu + Du gv) / (2 Du Dv)
equations.boundary_conditions: periodic on an interior ocellar-pigment patch; the ocellus rim is not a boundary of this domain

parameters.note: Du is fixed by the sechellia pin lambda_c=1.500 µm. gu is co-adapted so h(k_c^2)=-0.035. Not the alpha/beta power law of the 88 µm sibling slot.

santomea.mechanism: tan cis-regulatory loss lowers activator gain (Jeong 2008)

sechellia.mechanism: shavenbaby cis-regulatory loss of the larval trichome template; ocellar ommochrome lattice at onset (McGregor 2007, Frankel 2011)

serrata.mechanism: intermediate activator gain on the montium signal-trait / CHC background (Chenoweth & Blows 2005)

empirical_claims: Turing 1952: a homogeneous steady state that is stable without diffusion can be unstable at a finite k_c when the inhibitor diffuses faster than the activator.

Sucena & Stern 2000 and McGregor et al. 2007: D. sechellia lost larval trichomes through cis-regulatory mutations at shavenbaby. This slot does not simulate trichome cell shape; it places the remaining detail-scale pigment lattice at 1.5 µm.
Jeong et al. 2008: D. santomea abdominal pigmentation was reduced by tan enhancer loss. At this detail scale that is represented as a lower fu and a longer lambda_c (1.921 µm).
Shoup 1966 described pigment-granule assembly in D. melanogaster. It is a scale-class citation, not a measurement of 1.5 µm spacing in D. sechellia.

specimen.what_it_is: Nucleic-acid stained D. sechellia ovary. Anatomical anchor for image fitness. Not an image of the 1.5 µm ocellar lattice.

reported_in_source: Turing 1952 dispersion relation and the requirement Du ≠ Dv
D. sechellia larval trichome loss maps to shavenbaby cis-regulatory mutations
D. santomea tan enhancer loss reduces abdominal pigment
D. serrata signal traits are under mutual sexual selection
reconstructed_in_script: Near-onset Jacobians whose analytical lambda_c is 1.921, 1.680 and 1.500 µm
Fourier integrator, activator-gain sweep, equal-diffusion ablation, multi-seed CV, KS against a Gaussian ring
transfer_boundary: Ovary micrograph pixels are not ocellar pigment granules
Shoup 1966 granule ultrastructure is D. melanogaster
Chronospecies fu values are a comparative encoding of published gain-of-pigment differences, not fitted concentrations
does_not_claim: That ovarian nuclei are a Turing pigment pattern
That 1.5 µm was measured as a granule spacing in D. sechellia
That Morinda octanoic-acid resistance sets k_c
The 88 µm cellular wavelength of slot 2711
